I am the co-founder of brandempwr, a leading Shopify agency (https://brandempwr.com). Our mission is to empower ambitious businesses of all sizes, from start-ups to international brands, with cutting-edge Shopify and Shopify Plus solutions.

At brandempwr, we create stunning, high-performing e-commerce websites that are both visually appealing and strategically optimised. Our track record includes working with brands such as Food4Thoughts, TomsenSports, Grow&Glow and many more! You can check out our latest work examples at https://brandempwr.com/pages/work.

If you're looking to elevate your online presence and boost your e-commerce success, we would love to discuss your next project. Feel free to reach out to us at heather@brandempwr.com.

I'm also a pet lover so if you want to talk about animals go ahead 🐾
